description: Source file implementing the AudioTrackSourceImpl class, which manages audio track sources, observers, sinks, and frame data handling within the WebRTC streaming context.

classes.name: AudioTrackSourceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of an audio track source managing observers, sinks, and frame data for WebRTC streaming.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume for the audio track and notifies observers.

methods.name: RegisterAudioObserver
methods.description: Registers an audio observer to receive volume change notifications.

methods.name: AddSink
methods.description: Adds an audio sink to receive audio data.

methods.name: OnFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming audio frames and forwards data to sinks.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Returns the current state of the audio source.

methods.name: remote
methods.description: Indicates whether the source is remote; always returns false.
